name: Gallery
description: THEMCTF 2026 / Gallery: User-controlled data is rendered as template source instead of being passed as template context, allowing expression evaluation in the template engine. Injection type is Template Injection. Attack surface: user-supplied strings rendered back into the page: names, messages, error text, preview or profile fields. Recommended strategy: Page bodies are assembled with f-strings that embed usernames, filenames and report values, and the finished string is then handed to render_template_string. Anything an attacker stores therefore becomes template source on the next render, not escaped data. The /status page also emits {{ status | safe }} inside a script tag. Register or upload with a name that carries a Jinja expression and let the admin-facing render evaluate it.
vuln_type: Second-order SSTI: user data f-stringed into a render_template_string body
target_tech_stack: Python 3 + Flask (Jinja2) + file upload + admin gate
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves. Difficulty Medium-Hard (4) because the primitive is blind or heavily filtered and requires an oracle plus a gadget chain. Impact 9.1 because expression evaluation typically escalates to sandbox escape and arbitrary code execution.

agent_task: Find every place where stored user data is concatenated into the string later passed to render_template_string, choose the one reachable without admin rights, and escalate the Jinja expression to a file read or command execution.
